1.mascotDialogue: Balance factor's just left-height minus right-height. Anything outside [-1, 1] and — bam — rotation kicks in before we go any further. That's the whole self-balancin' trick right there.

2.mascotDialogue: `rotateRight` hoists the left child up to be the new root of this subtree, and hands its old right child down to the node that just got demoted — three pointer swaps, one operation.

3.mascotDialogue: After the rotation, 20's sittin' right on top, balance factor 0 on both sides. Without it, 30 would've had a balance factor of 2 — a straight leanin' line, not a tree no more.

4.mascotDialogue: That balance factor badge on node 30 — that's the tell. 2's a hard violation, right there plain as day, you don't gotta do the math yourself to spot it.
